summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of CYBER HQ theatrical classroom game. Verified launcher, secure command center, hacker intrusion sequence, all 3 mini-games (Identity, Secrets, Integrity), full win flow with victory certificate, and all presenter keyboard shortcuts. All critical flows PASS. Page uses body overflow:hidden and no scrollbars at 1920x1080.
action_items: Minor doc note: Intrusion sequence to reveal begin-mission-btn takes ~17-18s (not ~11s as stated in the request). Actual timing = 2.6s warning + ~8.5s hacker typing (4 lines @ 55ms/char + 750ms pauses + 900ms) + ~3s locks + CTA reveal delay. Enter shortcut skips this correctly. If a shorter theatrical duration is desired, reduce HACKER_LINES per-char interval from 55ms to ~25ms in IntrusionSequence.jsx, otherwise leave as-is.
critical_code_review_comments: IntrusionSequence.jsx: On line 58 the interval id is pushed into timers.current (which is cleared with clearTimeout on unmount). clearTimeout on an interval id may not fully cancel it — use clearInterval for safety, though the returned cleanup handles it on effect re-run.
GameContext RESET returns initialState with phase override to 'secure' but keeps `muted` — good; however it also resets `intruded:false`. This is intentional per spec (returns to a secure state).
App.js: 'u' shortcut is gated on `intruded` (line 74-79). Works as expected but could accidentally be a no-op if user presses 'u' before any mission start. Acceptable UX.
Consider adding a small aria-live region for screen readers on the intrusion messages (accessibility). Not blocking for a kiosk/classroom app.
test_credentials: None required — no auth in app.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is pure frontend keyboard-driven. Public URL: https://cyber-hq-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Must click enter-fullscreen-btn first to leave launcher. Shortcuts: h=intrude, 1/2/3=jump to mission, Enter=skip intrusion, f=victory, r=reset, p=help, u=force complete current mission (requires intruded=true), g/a=glitch/alarm overlays, m=mute. Mission 1 answers: DONT,TRUST,DONT,TRUST,DONT (wait ~1.8s between). Mission 2 password: CYBER via letter-{A..Z} then unlock-vault-btn. Mission 3: click tampered-cell-2, -6, -9. Intrusion sequence actually takes ~17s to auto-reveal begin-mission-btn.
